content: Recommendation: In our first release, we focus on conversational search and question answering tasks. We intend to provide support for conversational recommendation, e.g., BIBREF13, BIBREF14, BIBREF15, and joint search and recommendation, e.g., BIBREF16, BIBREF17, in the future.
